OTCI_VIRT_MODE.description: Virtualization mode for the test environment: xen, openstack, or ipmi.

OTCI_XEN_DOM0_IP.description: IP address of the Xen dom0 host used to provision VMs.

OTCI_XEN_VM_NAME.description: Name of the Xen VM to provision.

OS_AUTH_URL.description: Authentication URL for the OpenStack cloud where CI tests run.

OTCI_VM_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname of the VM where Tempest tests will execute.

OTCI_DEBIAN_IMAGE_ID.description: ID of the Debian image used to launch test VMs.

OTCI_INSTANCE_FLAVOR.description: Flavor ID used when launching test VMs.

OTCI_KEYPAIR_NAME.description: Name of the SSH keypair to use for VM access.

OTCI_FLOATING_IP_ID.description: ID of the floating IP allocated for the test VM.

OTCI_ETH0_NET_ID.description: Network ID for the primary network interface (eth0) of the VM.

OTCI_ETH1_NET_ID.description: Network ID for the management network interface (eth1) of the VM.

OTCI_IPMI_IP_ADDR.description: IP address of the IPMI interface on the physical hardware.

OTCI_IPMI_LOGIN.description: Login username for the IPMI interface.

OTCI_FLOATING_IP_ADDR.description: Floating IP address of the machine where OpenStack is installed, used for SSH.

OTCI_SSH_PORT.description: SSH port number for the test machine.

OTCI_MANAGEMENT_IFACE_NAME.description: Name of the management network interface.

OTCI_ETH1_CIDR.description: CIDR notation for the management network.

OTCI_PUBIP_START.description: Start of the public IP pool.

OTCI_PUBIP_END.description: End of the public IP pool.

OTCI_LOCAL_IP.description: Local IP address for the OVS agent.

OTCI_LASTMINUTE_FIXUPS.description: Whether to perform last-minute fixups for management IP and restart agents.

OTCI_DEBIAN_REPO_URL.description: URL of the default Debian repository.

OTCI_USE_SWIFT.description: Whether to use Swift storage in the test environment.
